about: Per-asset provenance for the MakeHuman crowd bodies (OpenTrident, 2026-10-28). Tool: MPFB2 2.0.18 in Blender 5.2 (GPL-3.0 add-on, a tool we ran, none of its code ships). Sources: the MakeHuman CC0 asset packs makehuman_system_assets_cc0 and skins01_cc0. Trimmed by the ARMAGEDOM repo to the 19 first-batch bodies that ship in Web/public/assets/crowd (the other 11 are not shipped); packs, caveats and the licence statement are OpenTrident's, unchanged. Batches 1 to 3 (28 Oct, second PR): 18 more bodies from OpenTrident's crowd batches (b1 5, b2 8, b3 5 of 30 built; 12 dropped, see PROVENANCE.md), each record carries a `batch` field; per-batch notes and packs under `batches`, PACKS.md per batch in packs-b1.md, packs-b2.md, packs-b3.md. Per-body record shapes differ slightly by batch (as delivered by OpenTrident).
licence_of_deliverables: CC0 1.0 (source assets CC0; rig, weights, packing are OpenTrident's own)

makehuman_system_assets_cc0.manifest: packs/makehuman_system_assets.json in the installed MPFB2 user data

caveats: The recorded rows are the build rows we kept. For some bodies the delivered GLB was rebuilt later (palette recolours, outfit parts), so the recorded outfit can differ from what is drawn: e.g. mh-woman-02's row says female_elegantsuit01 but the delivered body wears a tee and shorts. The GLB bakes all clothes and skin into shared texture atlases, so the exact per-body asset mapping cannot be read back from the file.
What is guaranteed: every asset in both installed packs carries licence CC0 in the pack's own manifest (counts above), so any asset used by any of the 30 is CC0 regardless of the recorded mapping.
The pack zip SHA256 sums were not kept (zips deleted); `asset_files` hash the installed files instead (sha256 per file, from the VPS MPFB2 user data).
Seven bodies carry the MakeHuman project's circular figure logo on a tee (stock CC0 clothes texture): mh-man-02, mh-woman-02, mh-gen-v2-0001, 0002, 0009, 0015, 0043.

b1.about: Per-asset provenance for the 10 MakeHuman crowd batch 1 bodies (OpenTrident, 2026-10-28). Tool: MPFB2 2.0.18 in Blender 5.2 (GPL-3.0 add-on, a tool we ran, none of its code ships). Sources: the MakeHuman CC0 asset packs makehuman_system_assets_cc0 and skins01_cc0 only.
caveats: Exact record: assets come from the rows file that was fed to Blender (defaults + per-body row), not guessed. The GLB bakes clothes and skin into shared atlases, so the mapping cannot be read back from the file; the rows are the record.
The basemesh proxy (MPFB2 built-in human) and the MPFB2 "mixamo" rig / GAMEENGINE skin settings are MPFB2 features, not pack assets.
asset files hashed are the installed files in the MPFB2 user data (/root/mpfb_asset_hashes.json); pack zip sums were not kept.

b2.about: Per-asset provenance for crowd batch 2 (10 MakeHuman bodies, OpenTrident/ARMAGEDOM, 2026-10-28). Tool: MPFB2 2.0.18 in Blender 5.2 headless (GPL-3.0 add-on, a tool we ran, none of its code ships). Sources: MakeHuman CC0 packs makehuman_system_assets_cc0 and skins01_cc0 only. Exact record: the assets listed are the ones MPFB2 loaded for that body (export.json "assets"), compared to the rows (rows_match_export).
caveats: Skin, clothes, hair, eyebrows, eyelashes, teeth and the eye mesh are exact (read back from the Blender run). The eye mesh uses the default eye material of the pack (brown.mhmat, brown_eye.png); blue eyes are a hue recolour (+180 degrees) of that brown texture (see recolour_palette).
Hair and suit colours are recolours (hue / tone) of the pack textures, listed per body in recolour_palette: the base asset is the pack asset named.
The pack zip SHA256 sums were not kept; files are hashed as installed (sha256 per file, /root/mpfb_asset_hashes.json regenerated by mpfb_hash.py at build time).
Clothes pool was limited to suits whose tee texture has no MakeHuman ring-figure logo (see PACKS.md); the final GLBs were close-up checked (chest.png).

makehuman_system_assets_cc0.manifest: packs/makehuman_system_assets.json in the installed MPFB2 user data

b3.about: Per-asset provenance for the 10 MakeHuman crowd bodies of batch 3 (OpenTrident / ARMAGEDOM, 2026-10-28, seed 20264028 = 20261028 + 3000). Tool: MPFB2 2.0.18 in Blender 5.2.2 (GPL-3.0 add-on, a tool we ran, none of its code ships). Sources: only the MakeHuman CC0 asset packs makehuman_system_assets_cc0 and skins01_cc0.
caveats: The record is exact: the asset names are the rows that were fed to Blender, and each body's Blender export log lists the same assets (asserted when this file was made).
Pack zip SHA256 sums were not kept; asset_files hash the INSTALLED files (sha256 per file, from the VPS MPFB2 user data), listed per asset and in installed_asset_files_sha256.
The GLB bakes clothes, skin, eyes and teeth into shared texture atlases, so the per-body mapping lives in the rows, not in the file.

Clothes assets carrying the MakeHuman chest logo (female_casualsuit01/02, male_casualsuit02/04/06) were NOT used; male_casualsuit03/05 and the other suits have no chest print. Every final body was checked with a chest close-up (chest.png, chestback.png).
